actual.ex: The actual cost was lower than we feared.

noteHi.usage: औपचारिक लेखन में आम; इसके बाद संज्ञा आती है।

roughly.ex: The trip takes roughly two hours.

singled.en: chose one thing for special attention

paragraphs: Doctors and nurses spend many hours on paperwork. Often they work late in the evening or at weekends to finish it.
MedWrite is a new Irish company. It uses AI to write notes and reports for doctors. A doctor then checks the notes and signs them.
The system can listen to a visit, if the patient agrees. Then it prepares the notes.
Four people started the company. One of them, David Menzies, is an emergency doctor and a professor at UCD. The system started in July 2025, and some private hospitals use it now.
The company now wants to raise about €2 million. It hopes to sell its system in the UK and the Gulf.

他們常常得工作到晚上或週末才能做完。
MedWrite 是一家新的愛爾蘭公司。
它用人工智慧幫醫生寫紀錄和報告。
接著由醫生檢查這些紀錄並簽名。
如果病人同意，這套系統可以聆聽看診過程。
然後它會準備好紀錄。
這家公司由四個人創立。
其中一位是大衛・孟席斯，他是急診醫師，也是都柏林大學學院的教授。
這套系統在 2025 年 7 月開始使用，現在已有一些私立醫院在用。
這家公司現在想募集大約 200 萬歐元。
它希望把系統賣到英國和波斯灣地區。

paragraphs: Doctors and other health workers spend a lot of time on paperwork, often in the evenings and at weekends. An Irish start-up called MedWrite says artificial intelligence can help.

MedWrite's platform writes clinical notes, care plans and reports. A person always checks the work. With the patient's permission, it can also listen to a consultation and prepare the notes. The doctor then reads them, makes changes and signs them off.

The idea began in 2023, when three of the founders worked together at the drug company Novartis. The fourth founder, David Menzies, is an emergency medicine consultant and a professor at UCD. He saw that sending patients home from hospital created a lot of paperwork. A study found the AI did this job better than the old manual way.
The system went live in July 2025. Users include Mater Private Hospital and St Vincent's Private Hospital. Hospitals pay for what they use.

So far, the company has spent about €1.3 million, including €250,000 from Enterprise Ireland. It has 18 staff in Ireland and the Middle East, and it now plans to raise about €2 million to grow in the UK and the Gulf.
sentZh: 醫生和其他醫護人員花很多時間在文書工作上，常常是在晚上和週末。
一家名叫 MedWrite 的愛爾蘭新創公司表示，人工智慧可以幫上忙。
MedWrite 的平台可以撰寫臨床紀錄、照護計畫和報告。
工作成果一定會由人來檢查。
在病人允許下，它也能聆聽看診過程並準備紀錄。
接著醫生會閱讀紀錄、修改內容並簽核。
這個構想始於 2023 年，當時三位創辦人一起在藥廠諾華工作。
第四位創辦人大衛・孟席斯是急診醫學主治醫師，也是都柏林大學學院的教授。
他發現讓病人出院回家會產生大量文書工作。
一項研究發現，人工智慧做這項工作比舊的人工方式更好。
這套系統在 2025 年 7 月上線。
使用者包括馬特私立醫院和聖文森私立醫院。
醫院依實際使用量付費。
到目前為止，公司已花費約 130 萬歐元，其中包括愛爾蘭企業局提供的 25 萬歐元。
公司在愛爾蘭和中東共有 18 名員工，現在計畫募集約 200 萬歐元，拓展英國和波斯灣市場。

paragraphs: Clinicians spend a significant share of their working lives on administration, frequently finishing paperwork in the evenings and at weekends. MedWrite, an Irish start-up, believes artificial intelligence can ease that burden.

Its AI-powered documentation platform captures, drafts and sends clinical notes, care plans and reports, always with human oversight. An "ambient" feature can listen to a consultation, with the patient's consent, and prepare notes that the clinician then reviews, edits and approves.

The concept emerged in 2023, when co-founders Seán Kirwan, Ahmad Albarqawi and Ruth MacIver were working together at the pharmaceutical firm Novartis. They were joined by David Menzies, an emergency medicine consultant and clinical professor at UCD, who identified patient discharge as a major source of paperwork. A comparative study found AI-assisted discharge outperformed the manual process.
The platform went live in July 2025 and is used by Mater Private Hospital, St Vincent's Private Hospital and Charter Medical. Customers pay licence and transaction fees based on usage.

Development has cost about €1.3 million so far, including €250,000 from Enterprise Ireland. The 18-strong team is now preparing a funding round of around €2 million to expand into the UK and the Gulf.
sentZh: 臨床醫護人員在工作中有相當大比例的時間花在行政事務上，經常在晚上和週末才完成文書工作。
愛爾蘭新創公司 MedWrite 認為，人工智慧可以減輕這項負擔。
它以人工智慧驅動的文件平台能擷取、草擬並傳送臨床紀錄、照護計畫和報告，且全程都有人工監督。
其「環境式」功能在取得病人同意後，可以聆聽看診並準備紀錄，再由臨床人員審閱、編輯和核准。
這個概念誕生於 2023 年，當時共同創辦人西恩・柯文、艾哈邁德・阿爾巴卡維和露絲・麥克艾佛正一起在製藥公司諾華工作。
後來急診醫學主治醫師、都柏林大學學院臨床教授大衛・孟席斯加入他們，他指出病人出院是文書工作的一大來源。
一項比較研究發現，人工智慧輔助的出院流程表現優於人工流程。
這個平台於 2025 年 7 月上線，目前由馬特私立醫院、聖文森私立醫院和查特醫療使用。
客戶依使用量支付授權費和交易費。
到目前為止，開發成本約 130 萬歐元，其中包括愛爾蘭企業局提供的 25 萬歐元。
這支 18 人的團隊正準備進行約 200 萬歐元的募資，以拓展英國和波斯灣市場。

paragraphs: Clinicians devote an inordinate amount of time to administration, routinely ploughing through paperwork late into the evening and at weekends. MedWrite, a fledgling Irish company, is betting that artificial intelligence can lighten that load.

Its platform captures, drafts and dispatches clinical notes, care plans and reports, invariably under human supervision. An "ambient" function can, with the patient's consent, listen in on a consultation and compile notes, which the clinician then scrutinises, amends and signs off.

The venture took shape in 2023, when Seán Kirwan, Ahmad Albarqawi and Ruth MacIver, then colleagues at the pharmaceutical giant Novartis, spotted the potential of large language models in healthcare. They were joined by David Menzies, an emergency medicine consultant and clinical professor at UCD, who singled out patient discharge as a notorious bottleneck. A comparative trial found that AI-assisted discharge surpassed the manual approach.
Live since July 2025, the system has been adopted by Mater Private Hospital, St Vincent's Private Hospital and Charter Medical, which pay licence and transaction fees in proportion to usage.

Roughly €1.3 million has been ploughed into development to date, €250,000 of it from Enterprise Ireland. The 18-strong team is now gearing up for a funding round of about €2 million to fuel expansion into Britain and the Gulf.
